aggregation_contract: Mean annotator variants within each observation/model first; then give each observation equal weight. Paired differences are comparator minus V35.
registration_constraints: Do not select a margin from statistical detectability alone.
Use operational harm tolerance and measurement repeatability in addition.
Keep official 2048-pixel PQ distinct from pq_512 in this calibration.
Freeze margins after completed S0-4 review and before any S1 result is read.
